note: achat d'un terrain de 19,72 acres et de bâtiments près du siège de San José, droits de redéveloppement compris ; SMCI y louait déjà un entrepôt
quote: On January 26, 2024, Super Micro Computer, Inc. (the "Company") entered into a purchase and sale agreement (the "Purchase Agreement') with Caracol Property Owner LLC (the "Seller") to purchase real estate from the Seller comprising approximately 19.72 acres of land and 293,906 square feet of buildings and improvements located in close proximity to the Company's headquarters space in San Jose, California (the "Property") "as is" for an aggregate purchase price of $80 million, subject to certain adjustments to be determined at closing.

note: acompte non remboursable sauf cas limités sur l'achat de 80 M$
quote: Under the Purchase Agreement, the Company made a deposit $10 million, which amount is non-refundable except in limited circumstances.
